SELECT
  (SELECT clinic_hours FROM clinic_settings WHERE id = 1) AS clinic_hours,
  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(
      CONCAT(
        ELT(da.day+1, 'Lun','Mar','Mié','Jue','Vie','Sáb','Dom'),
        ' ',
        DATE_FORMAT(da.start_time, '%H:%i'),
        '-',
        DATE_FORMAT(da.end_time, '%H:%i')
      )
      ORDER BY da.day, da.start_time SEPARATOR ', '
    )
    FROM doctor_availability da
    WHERE da.doctor_id = {{ Number($('Prep save medico').item.json.doctor_id) || 0 }}
      AND da.week_start = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
      AND da.is_unavailable = 0
  ) AS doctor_hours,
  (SELECT name FROM doctors WHERE id = {{ Number($('Prep save medico').item.json.doctor_id) || 0 }}) AS doctor_name,
  (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(context, '$.medico')) FROM conversation_state WHERE phone = '{{ $('Prepare Input').item.json.telefono }}') AS medico_saved;

SELECT
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(context, '$.medico')) AS medico,
  JSON_EXTRACT(context, '$.medico_cualquiera') AS medico_cualquiera,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(context, '$.doctor_id')) AS doctor_id,
  (SELECT clinic_hours FROM clinic_settings WHERE id = 1) AS clinic_hours,
  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(
      CONCAT(
        ELT(da.day+1, 'Lun','Mar','Mié','Jue','Vie','Sáb','Dom'),
        ' ',
        DATE_FORMAT(da.start_time, '%H:%i'),
        '-',
        DATE_FORMAT(da.end_time, '%H:%i')
      )
      ORDER BY da.day, da.start_time SEPARATOR ', '
    )
    FROM doctor_availability da
    WHERE da.doctor_id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(
      (SELECT context FROM conversation_state WHERE phone = '{{ $('Prepare Input').item.json.telefono }}'),
      '$.doctor_id')) AS UNSIGNED)
      AND da.week_start = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
      AND da.is_unavailable = 0
  ) AS doctor_hours
FROM conversation_state WHERE phone = '{{ $('Prepare Input').item.json.telefono }}' LIMIT 1;
